  Scenario: AC8 The deployment writes no owner table row and the row load runs in the owner's Flyway sequence (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the catalog rows are loaded in rwb_case by the owner's Flyway sequence
    When a release runs the parameter-catalog-seed hook
    Then the deployment writes no row of the owner's tables

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or gets no answer raises the failed-refresh alert (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the client reads the catalog and the values from rwb-case under /api/recovery/case/v1
    When a refresh call fails or gets no answer
    Then the failed refresh raises its own alert with the service, the key and the environment
    Then the panel counts the failed refresh for the environment

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the release model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a release in state Complete in SCR-44
    When the platform administrator asks to rerun it
    Then the rerun is refused and the release stays Complete
